_comment: Topic photos for the Photos sidebar of person stories, so the sidebar never repeats the inline subject portrait (Shannon, Oct 13). Files are vendored under public/content/photos/stories/<slug>--topic.jpg (no upscaling). scripts/dedupe-portrait-photos.mjs applies these in the build and drops a sidebar photo that matches the portrait when no row exists here.
